# pve_backup_run (Action)

Creates a backup with vzdump (`POST /nodes/{node}/vzdump`) and waits for the backup task to finish. Set `vmid` to back up specific guests, or `all`/`pool` to back up groups of guests. Requires the `VM.Backup` privilege on the backed-up guests and `Datastore.AllocateSpace` on the backup storage; several tuning options require `Sys.Modify` on `/` and `job_id`, `dumpdir`, `tmpdir`, and `script` are restricted to `root@pam` upstream.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# Run a snapshot-mode backup of guests 100 and 101 to the backup storage
# on node pve1 with zstd compression, keeping the ten most recent
# backups, and wait for the vzdump task to finish.
action "pve_backup_run" "nightly_vm_backup" {
  config {
    node     = "pve1"
    mode     = "snapshot"
    compress = "zstd"
    storage  = "backup-nas"
    vmid     = ["100", "101"]
    prune_backups = {
      keep_last = 10
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node running the backup; the task runs here.

### Optional

- `all` (Boolean) Backs up all known guest systems on this host.
- `bwlimit` (Number) I/O bandwidth limit in KiB/s. Must be 0 or greater; omit for no limit.
- `compress` (String) Compression of the dump file. Must be one of: `0`, `1`, `gzip`, `lzo`, `zstd`. Defaults upstream to `0` (no compression).
- `dumpdir` (String) Directory the resulting files are written to (alternative to `storage`). Restricted to `root@pam` upstream.
- `exclude` (List of String) Guest IDs to exclude (assumes `all = true`; sent on the wire as a comma-separated `pve-vmid-list`).
- `exclude_path` (List of String) Shell globs of files/directories to exclude (container backups). Paths starting with `/` are anchored to the container's root, other paths match relative to each subdirectory.
- `fleecing` (Attributes) Options for backup fleecing (VM only). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fleecing))
- `ionice` (Number) IO priority when using the BFQ scheduler (affects the compressor for VM backups); `8` means idle priority. Must be between 0 and 8.
- `job_id` (String) Backup job ID recorded in the backup notification's `backup-job` metadata field. Restricted to `root@pam` upstream.
- `lockwait` (Number) Maximal time to wait for the global lock, in minutes. Must be 0 or greater.
- `mailnotification` (String) Deprecated upstream in favor of notification targets/matchers: when to send a notification mail. Must be one of: `always`, `failure`.
- `mailto` (String) Deprecated upstream in favor of notification targets/matchers: comma-separated list of email addresses or users receiving notifications.
- `mode` (String) Backup mode. Must be one of: `snapshot`, `suspend`, `stop`. Defaults upstream to `snapshot`.
- `notes_template` (String) Template for the backup notes; supports the `{{cluster}}`, `{{guestname}}`, `{{node}}`, and `{{vmid}}` variables. Requires `storage`.
- `notification_mode` (String) Which notification system to use. Must be one of: `auto`, `legacy-sendmail`, `notification-system`. Defaults upstream to `auto`.
- `pbs_change_detection_mode` (String) PBS mode used to detect file changes and switch encoding format for container backups. Must be one of: `legacy`, `data`, `metadata`.
- `performance` (Attributes) Other performance-related settings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--performance))
- `pigz` (Number) Use pigz instead of gzip when greater than 0; `1` uses half the cores, higher values set the thread count.
- `pool` (String) Backs up all known guests included in this pool.
- `protected` (Boolean) Marks the backup(s) as protected. Requires `storage`.
- `prune_backups` (Attributes) Retention options overriding the storage configuration instead of it; `keep_all = true` conflicts with the other options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prune_backups))
- `quiet` (Boolean) Suppresses log output.
- `remove` (Boolean) Prunes older backups according to `prune_backups`. Defaults upstream to `true`.
- `script` (String) Hook script run at backup lifecycle events. Restricted to `root@pam` upstream.
- `stdexcludes` (Boolean) Excludes temporary files and logs. Defaults upstream to `true`.
- `stdout` (Boolean) Writes the archive to stdout instead of a file; the provider discards the stream, so this is only useful with hook scripts.
- `stop` (Boolean) Stops running backup jobs on this host before starting.
- `stopwait` (Number) Maximal time to wait until a guest is stopped, in minutes. Must be 0 or greater.
- `storage` (String) The backup storage the resulting file is stored on.
- `tmpdir` (String) Directory for temporary files. Restricted to `root@pam` upstream.
- `vmid` (List of String) Guest IDs to back up (sent on the wire as a comma-separated `pve-vmid-list`), e.g. `["100", "101"]`.
- `zstd` (Number) Zstd thread count; `0` uses half the available cores. Must be 0 or greater.

<a id="nestedatt--fleecing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fleecing`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enables fleecing for all equipped guests.
- `storage` (String) Storage holding the fleecing images; if not set, the storage selected by the scheduler is used.


<a id="nestedatt--performance"></a>
### Nested Schema for `performance`

Optional:

- `max_workers` (Number) Maximal number of parallel workers (per guest in stop/suspend mode, per drive in snapshot mode). Must be 1 or greater.
- `pbs_entries_max` (Number) Maximal number of entries for PBS in-flight file entries. Must be 0 or greater.


<a id="nestedatt--prune_backups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prune_backups`

Optional:

- `keep_all` (Boolean) Keeps all backups; conflicts with the other `keep_*` options.
- `keep_daily` (Number) Maximal number of daily backups to keep. Must be 0 or greater.
- `keep_hourly` (Number) Maximal number of hourly backups to keep. Must be 0 or greater.
- `keep_last` (Number) Maximal number of most recent backups to keep. Must be 0 or greater.
- `keep_monthly` (Number) Maximal number of monthly backups to keep. Must be 0 or greater.
- `keep_weekly` (Number) Maximal number of weekly backups to keep. Must be 0 or greater.
- `keep_yearly` (Number) Maximal number of yearly backups to keep. Must be 0 or greater.
